heard: So the word on the house of God in Jerusalem came to a halt. It stood still until the second year of the reign of Darius, king of Persia. The eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews. They were not stopped until a report could go to Darius Let the house be rebuilt as a place for offering sacrifices Let its foundations be laid with sixty cubits of height and width The cost is to be paid from the royal treasury I, Darius, have issued this decree
